install_addon.title: Install Freya App
install_addon.description:
The Freya app was not found. Please follow the steps below to install and start it:

#### 1. Add App Repository
{addon_badge}

> **Or add manually**: [👉 Open App Store](/config/apps/available) ➔ Top-right menu ➔ Repositories ➔ Add:
> `{repo_url}`

#### 2. Install and Start
Search for and install **Freya** in the App Store. Once started, click **Submit** below.

not_running.title: Start Freya App
not_running.description:
The Freya app is installed, but is currently **not running**.

Please go to [👉 Freya App Details]({app_info_url}) and start it.

Once started, click **Submit** below to complete setup.

cannot_connect.title: Failed to Connect to Freya Service
cannot_connect.description:
The Freya app is running, but Home Assistant is unable to connect to its internal communication service.

This usually occurs when the app is still starting up or has encountered an error.

Please check the logs in [👉 Freya App Details]({app_info_url}), then click **Submit** below to retry.

choose_install.title: Choose Deployment Type
choose_install.description: No local Freya app detected. Would you like to install the local app or manually configure an external Freya service?

manual_config.title: Configure External Freya
manual_config.description: Please enter the connection parameters for your independently deployed Freya service.

hassio_confirm.title: Freya App Discovered
hassio_confirm.description: A running Freya app has been detected. Do you want to set it up now?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the specified Freya service. Please check the URL.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid access credentials or wrong password.
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred. Please check logs.

abort.already_configured: Freya is already configured. Only one instance is needed.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress. Please continue in the existing card or dialog.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Freya app communication service. Please ensure the app is running.
abort.unsupported_ha_version: Freya requires Home Assistant 2026.2.0 or higher to support the new App architecture. Please update your Home Assistant.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Freya connection configuration has been successfully updated.

chat.name: Chat
chat.description: Send a text message to Freya and receive a response.

content.name: Content
content.description: The message text to send to Freya.
content.example: Summarize today's top tech news for me

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: Session ID for multi-turn conversations (optional, single-turn if omitted).

attachments.name: Attachments
attachments.description: Attachments to include (URLs or local file paths in Home Assistant).

toolboxes.name: Toolboxes
toolboxes.description: Active toolbox IDs (optional, supports a list or comma-separated string).

skill_id.name: Skill ID
skill_id.description: Target skill ID to prioritize or execute (optional).

language.name: Language
language.description: Expected language code for the response (optional, defaults to system language).
